name: @psyb0t/ibkr-httpapi
summary: Wire an OpenClaw agent to a self-hosted ibkr-httpapi (Interactive Brokers HTTP bridge) instance over MCP — REST-mirroring tools for market data, account/positions, and order entry.
description: A thin stdio<->HTTP bridge that connects an MCP client (OpenClaw, Claude, Cursor, Codex, ...) to a running ibkr-httpapi instance's MCP endpoint (/mcp), exposing the same REST surface as three generic tools: ping (gateway liveness), endpoints (the live OpenAPI catalog of every route), and request (call any REST endpoint by method/path/query/body). ibkr-httpapi is self-hosted — you run the server yourself and point this bridge at it. It fronts a LIVE Interactive Brokers account: order placement, cancellation, and option exercise are real, irreversible actions. See https://github.com/psyb0t/ibkr-httpapi.

IBKR_HTTPAPI_URL.description: Base URL of your running ibkr-httpapi server, e.g. http://localhost:8889 (the bridge appends /mcp/). Note: this is the app root, not the /v1 REST prefix.

IBKR_HTTPAPI_TOKEN.description: Bearer token — required whenever the server has api_token/API_TOKEN configured (the same token that guards the REST API; empty server-side token means auth is disabled).
